verses.ar: لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ زَمَانٌ، وَلِكُلِّ أَمْرٍ تَحْتَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَقْتٌ:
verses.kjv: To every [thing there is] a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
verses.web: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

verses.ar: لِلْوِلَادَةِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلْمَوْتِ وَقْتٌ. لِلْغَرْسِ وَقْتٌ وَلِقَلْعِ ٱلْمَغْرُوسِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up [that which is] planted;
verses.web: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

verses.ar: لِلْقَتْلِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلشِّفَاءِ وَقْتٌ. لِلْهَدْمِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلْبِنَاءِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.web: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

verses.ar: لِلْبُكَاءِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلضَّحْكِ وَقْتٌ. لِلنَّوْحِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلرَّقْصِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.web: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

verses.ar: لِتَفْرِيقِ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ وَقْتٌ وَلِجَمْعِ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ وَقْتٌ. لِلْمُعَانَقَةِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلِٱنْفِصَالِ عَنِ ٱلْمُعَانَقَةِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.web: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

verses.ar: لِلْكَسْبِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلْخَسَارَةِ وَقْتٌ. لِلصِّيَانَةِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلطَّرْحِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.web: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

verses.ar: لِلتَّمْزِيقِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلتَّخْيِيطِ وَقْتٌ. لِلسُّكُوتِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلتَّكَلُّمِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.web: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

verses.ar: لِلْحُبِّ وَقْتٌ وَلِلْبُغْضَةِ وَقْتٌ. لِلْحَرْبِ وَقْتٌ وَلِلصُّلْحِ وَقْتٌ.
verses.kjv: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.
verses.web: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

verses.ar: فَأَيُّ مَنْفَعَةٍ لِمَنْ يَتْعَبُ مِمَّا يَتْعَبُ بِهِ؟
verses.kjv: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?
verses.web: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

verses.ar: قَدْ رَأَيْتُ ٱلشُّغْلَ ٱلَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ ٱللهُ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ لِيَشْتَغِلُوا بِهِ.
verses.kjv: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.
verses.web: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

verses.ar: صَنَعَ ٱلْكُلَّ حَسَنًا فِي وَقْتِهِ، وَأَيْضًا جَعَلَ ٱلْأَبَدِيَّةَ فِي قَلْبِهِمِ، ٱلَّتِي بِلَاهَا لَا يُدْرِكُ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ ٱلْعَمَلَ ٱلَّذِي يَعْمَلُهُ ٱللهُ مِنَ ٱلْبِدَايَةِ إِلَى ٱلنِّهَايَةِ.
verses.kjv: He hath made every [thing] beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.
verses.web: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

verses.ar: عَرَفْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ خَيْرٌ، إِلَّا أَنْ يَفْرَحُوا وَيَفْعَلُوا خَيْرًا فِي حَيَاتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: I know that [there is] no good in them, but for [a man] to rejoice, and to do good in his life.
verses.web: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

verses.ar: وَأَيْضًا أَنْ يَأْكُلَ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ وَيَشْرَبَ وَيَرَى خَيْرًا مِنْ كُلِّ تَعَبِهِ، فَهُوَ عَطِيَّةُ ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it [is] the gift of God.
verses.web: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

verses.ar: قَدْ عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ كُلَّ مَا يَعْمَلُهُ ٱللهُ أَنَّهُ يَكُونُ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ. لَا شَيْءَ يُزَادُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلَا شَيْءَ يُنْقَصُ مِنْهُ، وَأَنَّ ٱللهَ عَمِلَهُ حَتَّى يَخَافُوا أَمَامَهُ.
verses.kjv: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth [it], that [men] should fear before him.
verses.web: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ فَمِنَ ٱلْقِدَمِ هُوَ، وَمَا يَكُونُ فَمِنَ ٱلْقِدَمِ قَدْ كَانَ. وَٱللهُ يَطْلُبُ مَا قَدْ مَضَى.
verses.kjv: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past.
verses.web: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

verses.ar: وَأَيْضًا رَأَيْتُ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّمْسِ: مَوْضِعَ ٱلْحَقِّ هُنَاكَ ٱلظُّلْمُ، وَمَوْضِعَ ٱلْعَدْلِ هُنَاكَ ٱلْجَوْرُ!
verses.kjv: ¶ And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, [that] wickedness [was] there; and the place of righteousness, [that] iniquity [was] there.
verses.web: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ فِي قَلْبِي: «ٱللهُ يَدِينُ ٱلصِّدِّيقَ وَٱلشِّرِّيرَ، لِأَنَّ لِكُلِّ أَمْرٍ وَلِكُلِّ عَمَلٍ وَقْتًا هُنَاكَ».
verses.kjv: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for [there is] a time there for every purpose and for every work.
verses.web: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

verses.ar: قُلْتُ فِي قَلْبِي: «مِنْ جِهَةِ أُمُورِ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ، إِنَّ ٱللهَ يَمْتَحِنُهُمْ لِيُرِيَهُمْ أَنَّهُ كَمَا ٱلْبَهِيمَةِ هَكَذَا هُمْ».
verses.kjv: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts.
verses.web: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ مَا يَحْدُثُ لِبَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ يَحْدُثُ لِلْبَهِيمَةِ، وَحَادِثَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لَهُمْ. مَوْتُ هَذَا كَمَوْتِ ذَاكَ، وَنَسَمَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ لِلْكُلِّ. فَلَيْسَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ مَزِيَّةٌ عَلَى ٱلْبَهِيمَةِ، لِأَنَّ كِلَيْهِمَا بَاطِلٌ.
verses.kjv: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all [is] vanity.
verses.web: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

verses.ar: يَذْهَبُ كِلَاهُمَا إِلَى مَكَانٍ وَاحِدٍ. كَانَ كِلَاهُمَا مِنَ ٱلتُّرَابِ، وَإِلَى ٱلتُّرَابِ يَعُودُ كِلَاهُمَا.
verses.kjv: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.web: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَعْلَمُ رُوحَ بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ هَلْ هِيَ تَصْعَدُ إِلَى فَوْقٍ؟ وَرُوحَ ٱلْبَهِيمَةِ هَلْ هِيَ تَنْزِلُ إِلَى أَسْفَلَ، إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ؟
verses.kjv: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth?
verses.web: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

verses.ar: فَرَأَيْتُ أَنَّهُ لَا شَيْءَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَفْرَحَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ بِأَعْمَالِهِ، لِأَنَّ ذَلِكَ نَصِيبَهُ. لِأَنَّهُ مَنْ يَأْتِي بِهِ لِيَرَى مَا سَيَكُونُ بَعْدَهُ؟
verses.kjv: Wherefore I perceive that [there is] nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that [is] his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
verses.web: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
